title: Artbitrator - AI Agent that judges players' drawings in real-time 1-12 Multiplayer. Voice Coms.
author: Silkutz
selftext:
Hi Everyone,

Link : [https://artbitrator.10kv.games/game](https://artbitrator.10kv.games/game)

I'm looking for playtesters and general feedback on my game Artbitrator.

Under the hood, it use an AI Agent + WebRTC RPC remote calls and ChatGPT 4o vision for analysis.

Draw the prompt quickly, AI judges and talks back while you draw, and scores live. 1 to 12 works now. curious what you think about it.

**Game Modes**

* 1-12 Multiplayer - Real-time drawing duels (LIVE NOW!)
* Gallery - Showcase your masterpieces
* Campaign Mode - 50 levels of progressive challenges (Coming soon)
* Daily Challenges - Compete on global leaderboards (Coming soon)
* Free Draw - Practice your skills (Coming soon)

Link : [https://artbitrator.10kv.games/game](https://artbitrator.10kv.games/game)

Thanks in advance kind people.

comments.author: _ryseu
comments.body: That’s actually a fun concept! I love the layout design. I tried playing the daily challenge tho what do I do after I draw what it gives me to draw? The timers running and I think the AI is guessing my drawing, but nothing is happening. I also tried the quick match, but again, idk if my drawings are bad, but the AI is just there analyzing. I suggest sharing this on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) too so more people can try it out and leave feedback. Hope that helps.

replies.author: Silkutz
replies.body: Ah, yeah, sorry, the daily challenge is bugged. Quick play multiplayer works great, though, so give that one a try!

comments.author: Downtown_Lettuce9911
comments.body: I don’t know what happens next or what I should do after drawing a space rocket, haha. I hope the AI appreciates my drawing skills, haha.
